cases.title: A group layer that jumped when parented has its own Position expression: the jump sentence says it as a clause beside the jump (not the cause), never 'can't see expressions', never 'no animation' or 'holds still'

checks.detail: turn 4: "an expression drives its X Position"

rubric.reason: Turn 4 says the jump and the expression in one sentence, with the expression as a side clause and not the cause: "Stamp is 120 px to the left of where it was at 0 s, and an expression drives its X Position too." It then gives Edit > Undo and a place to look, and never says it can't see expressions or that Stamp holds still.
Turn 4's "If the null moved after you placed it, that can show up here too" points to a place to look, as the rubric allows, and no turn states why Stamp jumped.

Every name and number comes from tool results: Tile, Caption, Stamp, Null 1, X Position (Stamp's own_expressions), 120 px, left and 0 s. Parent column and Edit > Undo are interface names, and the pivot lesson mention matches the learner record.

checks.detail: turn 4: "an expression drives its X Position"

rubric.reason: Turn 4 says the jump and the expression in one sentence, with the expression as a clause beside the jump rather than its cause: "it's 120 px to the left of where it was at 0 s, and an expression drives its X Position as well". It then gives Edit > Undo, and it never says it can't see expressions or that Stamp holds still.

Turn 4 gives no cause. "If the null moved after you placed it, that can show up here too" is phrased as a place to look, and the held-key line is asked only as a question ("Were you holding a key...?").

Every layer, property and time named comes from the tool results: Tile, Caption, Stamp, Null 1, X Position (Stamp's own_expressions), 120 px left at 0 s (the jumped hint), and the middle region (n3 region_now center). The Parent column pick whip and Edit > Undo are interface names.

checks.detail: turn 4: "an expression also drives its X Position"

rubric.reason: Turn 4 says "at 0 s it's 120 px to the left of where it was, and an expression also drives its X Position": the expression is a clause beside the jump in the same sentence, not given as its cause, followed by Edit > Undo, with no 'can't see expressions', no 'holds still' and no field key shown.

Turn 4 gives no cause: the expression is stated alongside the jump, "If the null moved after you placed it, that can show up here too" is phrased as a place to look, and the held-key line is asked as a question.

Every name and time the mentor used (Tile, Caption, Stamp, Null 1, X Position, 0 s, 120 px left, the center pivot, the learned pivot lesson) appears in the snapshot or check results, and 'Parent column', 'pick whip' and 'Edit > Undo' are plausible interface names.
